ops.title: Independent Codex port review: cc-notes and monorepo
ops.body:
verdict FINDINGS

scope
- Independent read-only correctness review of the Codex candidates in /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-notes/codex-ccn and /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/monorepo/codex-monorepo.
- Approved plan reviewed: cc-notes plan 486d766f6a2568cfe7eb6eb59442b6480baecacf.
- No monorepo port-specific correctness finding survived review. All findings below are in the cc-notes candidate.

finding 1
severity HIGH
path:line#hash .github/workflows/ci.yml:91#qct8; plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json:12#jmgt
trigger/impact The hook test job still installs capt-hook 12.46.1, while the changed pack imports Event.PostCompact and relies on the new Codex host/file APIs. The published plugin contract likewise still permits captain-hook >=12.0.0. The exact new CI command fails during hook-module import, before any Codex tests run, and an installation resolving an allowed older captain-hook cannot load the pack.
fix direction Release the Codex-capable captain-hook first, pin CAPT_HOOK_VERSION to that version, and raise the plugin dependency minimum to the same first compatible release. Re-run both the pack test and test_codex.py using only that released artifact.
evidence With an isolated temporary uv cache, `uv run --no-project --with 'capt-hook==12.46.1' python plugin/capt-hook/hooks/tests/test_codex.py` exited 1 at plugin/capt-hook/hooks/compact.py:372: `AttributeError: type object 'Event' has no attribute 'PostCompact'`. The 12.46.1 source enum contains PreCompact but not PostCompact.

finding 2
severity MEDIUM
path:line#hash plugin/capt-hook/hooks/common.py:233#grqj; internal/store/store.go:204#ek7q
trigger/impact Start Claude Code from a Codex-owned process so both CODEX_THREAD_ID and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID are inherited, then let a Claude hook call run_cc_notes. The Claude branch forwards the ambient environment unchanged, while store.session selects CODEX_THREAD_ID before CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID. Every such Claude hook write is stamped with the parent Codex thread instead of the active Claude session, violating host isolation and making provenance/history point at the wrong conversation.
fix direction Make the host-aware hook launcher neutralize the other host's inherited identifier while preserving CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID, including its explicit empty override. Add a Claude subprocess-path test with both native variables present, parallel to the existing MCP-only isolation test.
evidence In a temporary git repository, running the candidate CLI with `CODEX_THREAD_ID=parent-codex CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=child-claude` and no CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID produced note-history entries whose session was `parent-codex`. The Codex branch of run_cc_notes supplies an explicit env mapping; the Claude branch supplies none. TestClaudeMCPProvenanceIgnoresCodexParent proves only the MCP middleware path.

finding 3
severity MEDIUM
path:line#hash plugin/capt-hook/hooks/comments.py:62#v7e5
trigger/impact A native apply_patch FileChange carries per-file joined hunk fragments, not full pre/post file images. touched() feeds those fragments to touched_comment_blocks as though they were one file. Two disjoint three-comment hunks are concatenated into a synthetic six-line block and warn incorrectly; adding three comments immediately below four existing comments can remain a three-line fragment and bypass the no-narration guard even though the resulting file has seven consecutive comment lines.
fix direction Preserve hunk boundaries and reconstruct each patched file's full pre/post image before comment analysis, preferably in the normalized captain-hook file-change API. Add native apply_patch tests for separated hunks and for a new comment run extending unchanged neighboring comments.
evidence Two isolated candidate-wheel probes reproduced both directions: the disjoint-hunk case returned one CommentRun spanning lines 1-6 and VerboseCommentIntroduced=True; the adjacent-existing-comments case returned only lines 1-3 and VerboseCommentIntroduced=False.

validation
- PASS: `go test -race ./internal/mcpserver ./internal/store`.
- PASS: `go test ./internal/cli`.
- PASS: `PYTHONPATH=/tmp/codex-monorepo-venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/captain-hook/galeocerdo/.venv/bin/python plugin/capt-hook/hooks/tests/test_codex.py` (10 tests).
- PASS: the same candidate environment running `plugin/capt-hook/hooks/tests/test_cc_notes.py` (all helper unit cases).
- PASS: `PYTHONPATH=/tmp/codex-monorepo-venv/lib/python3.13/site-packages /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/captain-hook/galeocerdo/.venv/bin/python .capt-hook/tests/test_hosts.py` in codex-monorepo (6 suite methods, including the owner-described 273 policy replays).
- PASS: `git diff --check` in both candidate worktrees.
- PASS: built the cc-notes Codex plugin into a temporary directory, parsed both generated JSON files, and observed the generated MCP command, `mcp --host codex`, and env_vars for CC_NOTES_SESSION_ID and CC_NOTES_ACTOR.
- PASS: all 22 entries in /tmp/codex-port-monorepo-rollout.json matched both current candidate after_sha256 and untouched target before_sha256; no rollout drift.
- PASS: the six unchanged monorepo hook moves are byte-identical; the Slack hook's only behavioral port changes are BashCall.command normalization, the host-neutral history query, and a Codex owner-selector fixture. Linear/Sentry URLs match .mcp.json exactly, .claude/settings.json and .mcp.json are untouched, .claude/skills still resolves to .agents/skills, and no second project dispatcher is configured.
- FAIL as finding 1: the exact newly added CI invocation against capt-hook 12.46.1 cannot import the pack.

limitations
- Validation used /tmp/codex-port-dist/cc_transcript-14.19.0+codex.1-cp313-abi3-macosx_11_0_arm64.whl, SHA256 824b4ba95173f35350e17024350686d4136282a72a17e7506208141f670f8d36. The announced codex.2 wheel fixing inherited fork identity was not yet available, so its final replay/history regression run remains an integration gate.
- I inspected /tmp/codex-port-mcp-probe.txt and its raw-artifact references but did not repeat the live Codex app-server MCP probe. That evidence establishes per-call _meta.threadId, per-thread MCP processes/cwd, and absent CODEX_THREAD_ID in MCP child environments for Codex CLI 0.155.1.
- I did not apply /tmp/codex-port-monorepo-rollout.json, edit /Users/yasyf/Code/monorepo, modify global configuration/plugin caches, restart clients, or run final live CLI/desktop/Orca smoke tests.
- Generated __pycache__ files under the untracked monorepo .capt-hook test tree were ignored because the explicit rollout mapping does not include them.
